title: RCA: Mumbai West 4G Cluster Outage (INC-2026-0142)
content:
RCA: Mumbai West 4G Cluster Outage (INC-2026-0142)

Document ID: RCA_INC_2026_0142

Category: C08 — Network Coverage & Outages

Department: Network

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Incident Summary

A ~3-hour 4G outage affected approximately 40 sites in Mumbai West circle.

Incident Reference: INC-2026-0142

Business Impact

Customer-facing impact and any associated complaint/refund volume are tracked in the linked incident record and customer-care systems.

Technical Impact

Affected systems/sites and the duration of degraded or unavailable service are as recorded in the linked incident report.

Detection

Detected via monitoring/alarms or customer reports as documented in the linked incident report.

Timeline

Root Cause

Third-party road excavation work severed the primary fibre backhaul without prior utility-clearance coordination with NovaTel's infrastructure team.

Contributing Factors

No automatic failover to microwave backhaul was configured for this cluster.

Utility-excavation notification process with local municipal bodies had a gap for this corridor.

Five Whys

Why did the fault occur? Root cause as above. Why wasn't it prevented? Existing safeguards did not cover this failure mode. Why not? The scenario had not previously been observed at this scale, prompting the corrective actions below.

Resolution

Service was restored per the incident timeline; see linked incident report for full detail.

Corrective Actions

Configure automatic microwave backhaul failover for all clusters currently on single fibre path (target: 60 days).

Establish a proactive excavation-notification liaison with municipal authorities for high-risk corridors (target: 90 days).

Add this fibre route to the priority physical-protection (route diversity) programme.

Preventive Actions

Longer-term preventive measures are tracked alongside the corrective actions above and reviewed at the next governance cycle.

Monitoring Changes

Monitoring thresholds/alerts relevant to this failure mode are reviewed and updated where the investigation identified a detection gap.

Ownership

Actions 1 and 2 in progress; owner: Network Infrastructure team.

Status

Actions 1 and 2 in progress; owner: Network Infrastructure team.
